page.layout: One printed page: a decorative woodcut border (wreath with a mask at the top and a bird at the foot) enclosing the title text, centred; no running head, no page number.
page.notes: The woodcut border (wreath, mask at top, bird at base) is an engraving and is not transcribed. The title lines are set in large roman capitals; "POETICA PARA-" and "phrasis" are a word broken at the line end, the hyphen kept as printed. "eundem Vatem" is printed as "eunđ V atem" with a ligature-like form for "un"; read as "eundem Vatem".
